$description:
Design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Alexis Brochu personal design system. Edit values here only.

Approved 8-color palette:
  Card white  #FFFFFF   Base background
  Obsidian    #000000   Headings, primary button fill
  Body        #3F3B36   Paragraph copy
  Gravel      #777169   Secondary text, dates
  Slate       #A59F97   Tertiary / metadata
  Chalk       #E5E5E5   Borders, hairlines
  Powder      #F5F3F1   Muted fills, callout backgrounds
  Ember       #FF4704   SOLE saturated color. Used ONLY as: focus ring (ring token), a small decorative dot, or a short bold lead-in. NEVER as a background fill or border.

All semantic tokens derive from this palette. Destructive states use Obsidian (editorial convention: errors are typographic, not colored).
Radius: 0rem throughout.

border.$description: Chalk. Hairline rules and table borders.

primary.$description: Obsidian. Primary action fill — buttons, links, emphasis. NOT Ember.

secondary.$description: Powder. Secondary button and muted surface fill.

accent.$description: Chalk. Neutral hover/focus surface fill for menus, dropdowns, calendar selections. A neutral, never Ember.

accentForeground.$description: Obsidian. Text on chalk accent backgrounds.

destructive.$description: Obsidian. Destructive/error states use typography weight, not color. Editorial convention: errors are black, not red.

ring.$description: Ember. Focus ring only — the sole place Ember appears as a visible accent. Never a fill.

primary.$description: Powder. Primary action fill in dark mode.

mutedForeground.$description: Slate. Muted text in dark mode.

accent.$description: Dark-mode neutral hover surface (darker border tone). Never Ember.

destructive.$description: Powder. Dark-mode error states use foreground weight, not color.

ring.$description: Ember. Focus ring only — unchanged across modes.

serif.$description: Display typeface — name masthead, section titles, entry headings.

base.$description: Zero radius throughout. Editorial, document-grade brand. No rounding anywhere.
